subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off Feishu sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs config surface, and should merge wait for live Feishu pacing proof rather than mocked SDK-seam proof?
rationale: Source review shows a plausible Feishu-local implementation, but adding an operator-facing config key and accepting non-live timing proof require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted live Feishu output, logs, a terminal transcript, recording, or linked artifact proves same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

options.title: Accept Mocked Seam Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept fake-timer SDK-seam proof for this default-off config and proceed with normal merge review.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Close or replace the PR if maintainers decide OpenClaw should rely on reactive Feishu retry/backoff instead of a proactive pacing setting.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted live Feishu output, logs, a terminal transcript, recording, or linked artifact proves same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.
